scope: Galí, Monetary Policy, Inflation, and the Business Cycle (2nd ed.), Chapter 5: Monetary Policy Tradeoffs: Discretion versus Commitment, with Appendices 5.1-5.2 and Exercises 5.1-5.5. The cost-push tradeoff and the small-distortion loss; cost-push sources (corrected); optimal discretion and its implementation; the optimal commitment policy (deterministic and under uncertainty) and its implementation; commitment versus discretion; the inflation bias and its absence under commitment (corrected (26)-(27)); discretion and commitment at the zero lower bound; and the exercises.
source: Jordi Galí, Monetary Policy, Inflation, and the Business Cycle: An Introduction to the New Keynesian Framework and Its Applications, 2nd ed., Princeton University Press, 2015, Chapter 5, pp. 126-162.
